title.zh: OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company's culture is 'broken'

current_state.zh: A senior OpenAI safety leader resigned while publicly warning that the company's internal culture is 'broken', prompting debate about whether AI safety efforts are focused on present harms or hypothetical future risks.
